journey.intro: Your own journey through the night sky

1.title: First light
1.description: Start with familiar names and features. Meet the Moon, planets and constellations.

2.title: Observer
2.description: Where should you look, and what will you see? Connect your knowledge to the real sky.

3.title: Detective
3.description: Read the clues in starlight and observations. Explore what we know and what remains uncertain.

journey.locked: Earn 2 stars in the previous stage to unlock
journey.rules: Score 80% to earn a stamp and unlock the next stage. Earn stars at 60%, 80% and 100%, and up to 1,000 points for accuracy. There is no timer. Your total adds only your best score from each stage.
journey.nextUnlocked: You earned at least two stars. Ready for the next challenge?
journey.tryAgainNote: Read the explanations and try again. Score at least 80% to unlock the next stage.
journey.noStories: No stories match. Try another name.
journey.badgesIntro: Small moments of observing, recording and learning become achievements.
journey.noBadges: Your collection starts with your first observation.
